summary: Iteration 11 tested the new Local Qwen LLM + KB-template feature end-to-end. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_11.py = 4/4 green: settings analysis_mode round-trips ('kb' <-> 'llm'), manual KB add with client_id='ALL' persists and is listed under All Tenants, KB-mode /investigate returns generated_by='kb-template:<alert name>' (artifact substitution confirmed), LLM-mode /investigate returns in 0.2s with llm_status=pending and background Qwen updates mssp_report.generated_by to 'llm:qwen/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct' within ~20s (status=done). Frontend Playwright E2E was fully green: (1) Settings > Local LLM tab shows both llm-mode-kb and llm-mode-llm cards, selecting KB and clicking btn-save-settings persists across a hard reload (active card retains cyan-500 border). (2) Knowledge Base page (route is /knowledge-base) exposes kb-scope-select and switching to 'All Tenants (global)' reloads the entries. (3) kb-manual-form submits with alert_name='Multiple Login Failures for Single Username', analysis text containing template placeholders, verdict=Suspicious, recs; entry saves (toast + KB table update). (4) KB MODE end-to-end: opened offense #1004 (Multiple Login Failures for Single Username), clicked Re-Run AI Analysis (btn-investigate), MSSP report tab shows offense-mssp-report-source badge = 'KB Template · 100%' with verdict 'SUSPICIOUS', and analysis lines include 'This alert matches the knowledge-base template ... (name match 100%). Reusing the documented analysis and adapting it to this offense's artifacts.' + 'Observed artifacts in this offense — Source IP: 10.11.4.14; Destination IP: 172.17.51.7; Username: 4421; Time: 07 Sep 2026, 07:28:46; Offense ID: 1004.' Recommendations correctly rendered from the manual entry ('Enable MFA; Lock account after N failed logins.'). (5) LLM MODE end-to-end: switched analysis_mode to llm, re-investigated same offense — the response was immediate, data-testid llm-pending-banner appeared (cyan banner), and within one poll (~6s) the offense-mssp-report-source badge auto-updated to 'Local LLM' and a toast 'Local LLM finished refining the report' fired. (6) Reset analysis_mode back to KB at end of run as instructed. Local Qwen 0.5B inference works on CPU in this env.
